text:
invoice-bot: New invoice from Aurora Metrics: INV-AM-778 for $5,700. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-AM-778. Vendor references PO: PO-11420. Extracted total doesn't match expected contracted rate. Please review.

nina_fin: Quick read 1: contract discount (promo Q1 trial) should have applied 20% discount on platform fees. Invoice shows full platform line $4,500 instead of $3,600. Remaining $2,100 is training services (PO-11420 covers only platform).

sam_proc: Procurement confirms PO-11420 was created for platform only and included the promo code in the PR notes. Did vendor omit the discount on their side?

vendor-bot: Auto-reply from Aurora: "Our billing system didn't pick up promo code PROMO-Q1 because PO metadata didn't include the promo code field. We can issue a corrected invoice if you resend the PO with the code attached or provide a credit note."

alicia_ap: AP will not approve the overcharge. Options: 1) request credit note/reissued invoice (preferred), 2) create manual credit in our ledger and pay net (needs finance sign-off), 3) hold payment pending vendor correction. Due date in 6 days.

mark_eng: Contract team confirmed promo applied at order time. We have signed SOW and promo code in Confluence. I can attach the SOW snippet to the AP ticket.

sam_proc: Procurement can resend PO-11420 with the promo metadata (PO update) but vendor said they need either the updated PO on their side or our credit note request. Which path is fastest?

nina_fin: Fastest for vendor is to issue a credit note. I'll email Aurora billing asking for a credit note referencing INV-AM-778 and the promo code PROMO-Q1. I'll also attach SOW and PO notes. If they can't credit within 48h we'll create internal accounting adjustment and pay the net amount.

vendor-bot: Aurora billing reply: "We can issue a credit note and reissue invoice. Expect INV-AM-778-CN within 24 hours. Please confirm billing contact is billing@redwood."

alicia_ap: Great — put HOLD-PRICE-DISPUTE on the invoice. AP will schedule payment once credit note arrives or after net amount approval by @nina_fin.

procurement-bot: Note: If PO metadata is updated after the fact, Coupa will not retroactively match the original invoice. Please ensure vendor attaches the credit note when reissuing.

nina_fin: Thanks. I'll update AP ticket AP-6123 and confirm once credit note received. If we don't see credit in 24h escalate to procurement for a PO update.

sam_proc: I'll stand by to resend PO-11420 with promo metadata if vendor needs it. Keep me posted.

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-AM-778 status: vendor indicated credit note will be sent. Thread closed for now; will reopen if no credit in 24h.
